# EXIF tag value

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:exifTagValue`](gmeow-exifTagValue.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/exifTagValue>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/images`](../../slices/images.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The value of an EXIF tag — 'f/2.0', '1/1595', 'sRGB'. Projects to schema:PropertyValue/value. The human-readable tag name ('Aperture') rides [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) → [schema:name.](https://schema.org/name.)

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ExifTag`](../classes/gmeow-ExifTag.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:exifTagValue`](gmeow-exifTagValue.md) from [`gmeow:ExifTag`](../classes/gmeow-ExifTag.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
